title: Shared definitions for the experiment <-> simulation bridge

repo.description: Which agent produced a thing. Never inferred.

evidence.description: How a number came to exist. Maps to BD tier at import time, never guessed.

ref.description: A pointer into the other repo. 'am:' / 'bd:' prefix is load-bearing.

field.description: dotted path inside the referenced artefact

quantity.description: A dimensional value in the unit it was MEASURED in. Never pre-normalised to SI by the sender -- see README rule W2.

tier.description: BD tier. Optional on the wire: the importer derives it from `evidence` via README table T1.

chain.description: Ancestry of THIS number. Required for the cycle check (validator rule R5).

requirement.description: A dimensional range the receiving agent's own gates can check directly. BD produces these by inverse-mapping a dimensionless group; AM consumes them without ever seeing the group.

hard.description: false = degrades the answer, true = invalidates it

from.description: Prose derivation. NOT binding on the receiver's machinery; it exists so a human can audit the inverse map.

basis_group.description: name of the group in `regime` this came from

group.description: A dimensionless group. Shape deliberately matches bdbot spec.json `groups[]` so BD's adapter is a copy.

tolerance.description: e.g. 'within x2', '< 1e-3'. Prose because the admissible form differs per group.

why_this_tolerance.description: Sensitivity of answering_quantity to this group. Taste is not an answer.

counterpart.description: the other side's value for the same group, if known

assumption.description: The ONLY block that cannot be derived from numbers. 'no Faxen wall correction' does not follow from any value, so it must cross explicitly.

theirs.description: what the other side assumes, once known

worth.description: How much this assumption moves answering_quantity. null = not yet quantified, which becomes next round's task.

reply_to.description: relative path of the ask this answers

status.description: draft = an assumption is still `unknown`. blocked = evidence missing. unrunnable = capability missing (BD has no runner for the card / AM has no registered bead of that size).

precision.description: The one free number that MUST cross. Without it the receiver's gates are unconstrained and any plan passes.

confirmed_by.description: HUMAN ONLY. Validator rule R7 refuses any machine-looking name.
